THE LITTLE MEASURE DESK

Pixel Kitchen

A pinch of math for your next recipe.

Your measures

    1 cup = 16 tbsp = 48 tsp = 240 ml

# Pixel Kitchen Converter

A small offline browser app for converting kitchen measures among cups, tablespoons, teaspoons, and millilitres.

## Run

Open `index.html` in any modern browser. The app uses only local HTML, CSS, and JavaScript; it needs no server or internet connection.

Enter an amount and choose its unit. The other three units update automatically. Results are rounded to one decimal place for display; calculations retain full precision until then.

## Conversion reference

- 1 cup = 16 tablespoons
- 1 cup = 48 teaspoons
- 1 cup = 240 millilitres

Controls have visible keyboard focus styles. Use Tab to move between the amount field, unit selector, and Convert button; press Enter on the button to convert.
